MaximumFrame.Evidence: Single maximum W: round-trip, not latency ranking or production recovery acceptance

Results.Method: Seven sample rotations; real OS CSPRNG included in Prepare; no observation dictionaries in timed region. Buffered W: I/O with separate FlushToDisk; OS warm checked reads outside writer timing. No production implementation or deterministic random-loop time bound.

PythonVerification.crc_oracle: Python table-based CRC32C, plaintext coverage forward and trailer backward

RandomPythonVerification.crc_oracle: Independent Python bitwise CRC32C, forward coverage and reverse-byte trailer

Acceptance: Guarded Release run; 7 rotated samples, all kernels unchanged during measurement. Production src unchanged. CPU observations are untimed separate preparations; no deterministic time bound for random-loop search, no cold SSD or production recovery acceptance.
